text:
mira: Putting a quick mock up on the billing page — thinking about a ‘zoom to chart’ flow instead of the current expand panel. Goal: let people drill into a time range and keep the token breakdown pinned.
jon: curious — is that like a modal or inline zoom?
mira: inline. you click a region on the spend chart, it 'zooms' and shows a pinned right rail with token-tier bars and invoice CTA.
pauline: i like keeping token breakdown visible. quick nits: make sure invoices CTA stays primary and not lost in the rail when zoomed.
alex: +1. for keyboard users we should keep the rail focusable. If zoom opens, focus should move to the rail header and pressing esc should return to chart.
mira: good call — accessibility was on my mind. propose: focus trap for the zoom state, but allow escape to go back. aria-live for the updated totals so screenreaders hear new numbers.
jon: what about breadcrumb for drill path? users might want to go back to week -> month -> year.
mira: breadcrumb sounds good. small stub above chart: "Zoomed: 3/1–3/7 » Month view". Click to step back.
pauline: microcopy: instead of "Download invoice" maybe "Download invoice (PDF)" so users know format. also need visible file-size estimate?
alex: can we move the download button to the top-right of the rail instead of bottom? mobile layout might need it above the fold.
mira: mock shows both: top-right primary, footer secondary. on mobile primary becomes header action.
prod-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy.redwood.dev/preview/billing-zoom-2150009876 — thanks for the ping.
jon: looked at the preview. spacing feels dense between the token rows. can we add 8px vertical gap and increase label contrast? current 12/16 ratio is borderline.
pauline: also color considerations — token-level colors should maintain 4.5:1 contrast with background for text overlays.
alex: from engineering: keeping the token breakdown pinned will affect caching; need to ensure we don't re-fetch heavy aggregation on every zoom. suggest passing cached aggregates client-side and only request deltas for exact ranges.
mira: noted. i’ll add that to the handoff: include cached aggregates and a 'freshen' toggle.
jon: final ask — when zooming, animate height change gently (150ms) to help orientation. non-animated instant jump is confusing.
mira: agreed. will update prototype and add a11y checklist: keyboard nav, aria-live totals, focus management, color contrast, PDF label.
pauline: love it. can we get copy review after update? small wording for breadcrumb and CTA.
mira: yes — will post updated preview tomorrow and tag y'all. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks!
prod-bot: Reminder: design review session scheduled Friday 10:30am (calendar invite sent).
